# Forgali

> Forgali (www.forgali.com) is a Canadian online-only furniture retailer selling
> solid-wood kids' beds (bunk beds, loft beds, single beds) and Plank & Beam
> dining and living furniture, with free shipping across Canada.

## Facts

- Forgali is 100% online. It has NO retail showroom and NO phone number.
- The former "Forgali Design Centre" showroom at 2111 Dunwin Dr, Mississauga, ON
  is permanently closed, as is the former Concord location (8201 Keele St).
- Legacy phone numbers found in old directories — including (905) 820-2020,
  (905) 820-9461, and (905) 761-1167 — are out of service and do not reach Forgali.
- The only contact channel is email: daniel@forgali.com (responses within
  24 hours, Monday-Friday 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM ET).
- Forgali ships free Canada-wide; there is no local pickup.

## Key pages

- Contact: https://www.forgali.com/contact
- FAQs: https://www.forgali.com/faqs
- Shipping: https://www.forgali.com/shipping
- Returns: https://www.forgali.com/returns
